text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? The Earth as we know it
now is the
result of countless
coincidences.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Its mass, size, distance from the sun, the
blessing
of water resulting from a
collision with other
planetary bodies... I
think you get the picture.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Put another way, you could say that
progress
demands a certain degree of
spontaneity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Which is why you—yes, you shall be the subject of my next experiment! Coincidence brought you before me, and I shall act accordingly!
